title: 第23章 我的剑出鞘会见血第24章 气血如洪炉一剑败敌众皆哗然
slug: 满级武圣从绝世神功开始
content_zh:
天色渐晚，苏家长房院子里。
张宿与大哥张辰坐在院子里的树下。
四周静悄悄的。
下人们也都自觉地远离两人，不敢打扰。
张辰拿起桌上的酒杯，一饮而尽。
“咳咳咳……”
酒很辣。
呛得张辰不断地咳嗽。
张宿看着大哥。
记忆中，大哥是那个埋头苦读，温文尔雅的文弱书生。
可现在，大哥虽然依旧温文尔雅，但却成熟了许多。
“大哥，别喝了，你身子虚。”
张宿拦住了张辰。
“哈哈哈，没事，我今天高兴。看到你能在归元派练出一些名堂，我也就放心了，九泉之下的爹娘，也一定会很高兴。”
张辰是真的高兴。
他和张宿说了一下午的话。
似乎还意犹未尽。
不过，张辰说来说去，都是说张宿怎么怎么有出息了。
让他很欣慰。
却从不说他的艰辛。

可张宿清楚，大哥承受了很多。
曾经的大哥，只是苦读诗书，两耳不闻窗外事的文弱书生。
如今的大哥，却要在生意场上精于算计，与那些尔虞我诈的商人交锋，很是劳心费神。
而且，苏家也并不安稳。
“大哥，你辛苦了……”
张宿也不知道该说些什么。
千言万语，只汇成一句话。
“辛苦……哈哈哈，二弟，你能明白我的苦心，我就很高兴了。”
“其实，最辛苦的时候已经过去了。我虽然入赘苏家，可蓁蓁待我极好，岳丈也很信任我，把长房的生意都交到了我的手中。”
“试问，哪一个赘婿能被如此信任？”
“现在我和蓁蓁有了虎头，你也在归元派站稳了脚跟，小妹也到了说亲的年纪……我真的很高兴。过几天，我们三人一起去祭拜一下爹娘吧……”
张辰说着，人已经睡着了。
刚才喝了不少的酒。
本来张辰酒量就不行。
喝醉也正常。
这时，嫂子苏蓁蓁带着下人来了，看到张辰这副模样，也没有责怪，反而满眼都是心疼。
“二弟，你也别怪嫂子多嘴，你大哥，他心里装了太多的事，也承担了太多，你这次能回来，他是发自内心的高兴，我已经很久没看到他这么高兴了……”
苏蓁蓁一挥手，下人们小心翼翼地搀扶着姑爷，将其带回房里。
张宿没有醉。
他此前还有些忐忑。
content_en:
It was getting late, in the yard of Su's parents' house.
Zhang Su and his eldest brother Zhang Chen were sitting under the tree in the yard.
It was quiet all around.
The servants also consciously stayed away from the two people and did not dare to disturb them.
Zhang Chen picked up the wine glass on the table and drank it in one gulp.
"Cough cough cough..."
The wine is very spicy.
It choked Zhang Chen and kept coughing.
Zhang Su looked at his elder brother.
In my memory, my eldest brother was the frail scholar who studied hard and was gentle and elegant.
But now, although the eldest brother is still gentle and gentle, he has become much more mature.
"Brother, stop drinking, you are weak."
Zhang Su stopped Zhang Chen.
"Hahaha, it's okay. I'm happy today. I feel relieved to see that you can achieve some success in the Guiyuan Sect. My parents under Jiuquan will also be very happy."
Zhang Chen was really happy.
He and Zhang Su talked all afternoon.
It seems that there is still more to be desired.
However, Zhang Chen kept talking about how Zhang Su became promising.
It made him very happy.
But he never talked about his hardships.
But Zhang Su knew that his eldest brother had endured a lot.
The former eldest brother was just a weak scholar who studied poetry and books and had no ears to hear what was happening outside the window.
Today's eldest brother has to be good at calculations in the business world, and it is very tiring and troublesome to fight against those intrigues and deceitful businessmen.
Moreover, the Su family is not stable.
"Brother, you have worked hard..."
Zhang Su didn't know what to say.
Thousands of words are condensed into one sentence.
"Hard work... Hahaha, second brother, I'm very happy if you understand my painstaking efforts."
"Actually, the hardest time is over. Although I married into the Su family, Zhenzhen treated me very well, and my father-in-law also trusted me and left all the business of the eldest family in my hands."
"Let me ask, which son-in-law can be so trusted?"
"Now that Zhen Zhen and I have Hutou, you have also established a firm foothold in the Guiyuan sect, and my little sister has reached the age of marriage... I am really happy. In a few days, the three of us will go to pay homage to our parents..."
Zhang Chen said that he had already fallen asleep.
I just drank a lot of wine.
Originally, Zhang Chen was not good at drinking.
Getting drunk is normal.
At this time, sister-in-law Su Zhenzhen came with her servants. Seeing Zhang Chen's appearance, she did not blame him, but her eyes were filled with distress.
"Second brother, don't blame your sister-in-law for talking too much. Your eldest brother, he has too many things on his mind and has taken on too many things. He is sincerely happy that you can come back this time. I haven't seen him so happy for a long time..."
Su Zhenzhen waved her hand, and the servants carefully supported her uncle and brought him back to the room.
Zhang Su was not drunk.
He was still a little nervous before.
